text: Thanks Sam! Now sport's gone global in a big way. The NFL just announced they're playing a record nine international games across six countries in 2026, including the first ever games in Australia, Paris, and Rio.

speaker: alice
text: The Melbourne Cricket Ground gets the Rams versus 49ers in Week 1, and Rio's iconic Maracana Stadium hosts Cowboys versus Ravens. It's like the world's becoming one giant sports playground.

speaker: charlie
text: And May's been declared National Physical Fitness and Sports Month in the US. With the FIFA World Cup and Olympics coming up, there's this massive push to get people moving and celebrating what sport can do to bring us all together.
